claims.claim_text: 江水 continues east past 杨歧北山, then to 故市口; 江水左會高口 (Yangtze River passes Yangqi Northern Mountain, then reaches old market port, joining with Gaokou on left).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 江水又右杨歧北山 / 江水又东得故市口 / 江水左會高口

claims.claim_text: 江水 flows east-north past 公安縣北; 油水 joins from southwest at 油口 (Yangtze flows past Gong'an County; Youshui River enters from southwest at Youkou).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 又東經公安縣北 / 又東南油水从西南来注之又東右合油口

claims.claim_text: 屏陵縣之樂鄉城 sits south of 江水 against 大江 (Pingling's Lexiang City is described as on the south bank of the Yangtze, leaning against the great river).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 江水又南平郡屏陵縣之樂鄉城北 / 山抗大江山東有城故華容縣尉舊治地

claims.claim_text: 華容縣尉舊治 located at the mountain foot east of 江; 黃州 referenced as facing 江浦 (Huarong County seat was at east-of-Yang foot of mountain; Huangzhou faced the riverbank).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 山抗大江山東有城故華容縣尉舊治地 / 江浦也對黄州

claims.claim_text: 澧水 joins the larger system at 陂湖, with 渊 (deep pool) (Lishui River joins at Beihu, with deep pool).
河水 在河内地区有 野王縣 with 溝喬 / 長明陂 (He River in Henei region: Yewang County with Gouqiao / Changming Marsh).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 有二源北水上承河内野王縣東北界溝喬長明 / 陂南北二十許里東西三十里西则蔡溝人焉水

claims.claim_text: 修武城 西北二十里 包含 吴澤水 — 引用《魏土地記》(Xiuwu City, 20 li northwest, contains Wuze Marsh — quoting 魏土地記).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 澤矣魏土地記日修武城西北二十里有吴澤水

claims.claim_text: 滕公 濟渡玉門津, 宿小修武; 吴侯國 also called 大修武 (Duke Teng crossed Yumenzhen Ferry, then lodged at Xiao Xiuwu; Wu marquisate was also called Da Xiuwu).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 奥滕公濟自玉門津而宿小修武者也大即吴 / 侯國亦日大修武有小故大小修武在東

claims.claim_text: 漢高帝 八年 (197 BCE) 封都尉 魏邀 為 武王 (Emperor Gaozu's 8th year, 197 BCE, conferred the title of Martial King upon commandant Wei Yao).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 漢高帝八年封都尉魏邀為 / 武王伐勒

claims.claim_text: 易水 flows south past 范陽縣 and 容城縣 — but full continuity text partial in current OCR (Yi River passes Fanyang and Rongcheng counties; full route description not fully OCR'd).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 東過范陽縣南又东過容城縣南

claims.claim_text: 金毫陂 dimensions: 東西六七十步, with 百步 臺陂 around it (Jinhao Marsh: 60-70 steps east-west, with Baibu Terrace Marsh surrounding it).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 更属佳觀失其一水東出金毫陂東西六七十步南 / 邃岸高深左右百步一毫参差交時超相望

claims.claim_text: 一水 flows past 故安城 西侧城南 注易水 (A waterway runs past the west and south of Gu'an City, entering Yi River).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 臺陂一水經故安城西侧城南注易水灰塘崇峻

claims.claim_text: 汾水 south of 代城, with 稽石側; described as 潭波襄轉泛 (Fen River south of Daicheng, with Jishi side; described as having whirling ripples and abundant flow).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 東塘稽石侧枕汾水俗之代城城又南出一 / 雲垂煙接自是水流潭波襄轉泛

claims.claim_text: 汝水 東北流經 霍陽山 and 霍陽聚; 霍陽山水 joins at 南山 (Ru River flows northeast past Huoyang Mountain and Huoyang Settlement; Huoyang Mountain Water joins at Southern Mountain).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 日河南梁躲有靈山者世其水东北流經霍陽 / 霍陽聚汝水其北东合霍陽山水水出南山杜

claims.claim_text: 汝水之右: 陽人城 = 古梁之陽人聚; 秦减東周 reference (East of Ru River: Yangren City = ancient Liang's Yangren Settlement; reference to Qin conquering Eastern Zhou).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 汝水之右有 / 秦减东周徙其君此陂水東南流合乎潤水 / 口水上承陽人城東睿公陂城古梁之陽人聚也

claims.claim_text: 漢獻帝 (山陽公) at 鹿城; 建安二十五年 (220 CE) 封 — full surrounding text not fully OCR'd (Han Xiandi as Shanyang Gong at Lucheng; Jian'an 25 = 220 CE).
claims.ocr_excerpt: 鹿城西建安二十五年魏封漢献帝為山陽公

claims.claim_text: 吴陂 receives 荷泉 + 覆金堆 南北二十五里 — full geographic context partial in current OCR (Wubei receives He Spring and Fujin Mound, 25 li north-south).
